codeReview.summary: The sidebar UI, i18n coverage, and basic interaction tests are present, but the implementation misses two required conversation-state behaviors from the feature contract.

issues.description: `startNewConversation()` only clears local state and sets `conversationId` to `null`; it never creates or reserves a fresh conversation via `assistantMemoryService.createConversation()`/`resolveLatestConversation()`. Tapping New Chat therefore does not generate a new conversation ID as required by VAL-UI-004 and the feature description.

`loadRecentMessages()` hard-caps restored history to 20 turns, and `useAssistant.loadConversation()` calls it without overriding that limit (`src/hooks/use-assistant.ts:195`). Selecting a conversation therefore truncates longer threads instead of restoring the full message history required by VAL-UI-006.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The frontend-worker guidance and architecture note cover Animated refs in general, but they do not mention the React Hooks v7 `react-hooks/refs` lint suppression needed when an `Animated.Value` ref is passed directly into JSX style props.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: The worker handoff at `/Users/ashishhuddar/.factory/missions/3b1a7cfb-d88a-401b-9d72-9169dc74b157/handoffs/2026-03-14T19-53-17-692Z__ui-conversation-sidebar__f68ae63d-9adb-4f78-bd64-50e6c6fc8fcf.json` records `skillFeedback.followedProcedure: true` plus a suggested change to document this lint rule, and `src/components/assistant/ConversationSidebar.tsx` now includes `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/refs` comments around `backdropAnimRef.current` and `slideAnimRef.current`.

summary: Reviewed the feature handoff, transcript skeleton, commit `fc251b8`, and the affected current files. The sidebar UI is implemented, but the feature still fails its contract because New Chat does not create a new conversation ID and conversation restoration is limited to the latest 20 turns.
